munch.options.title: Munch
munch.options.enabled.tooltip: Turn every eating and drinking animation on or off.
munch.options.others.tooltip: Show bites and draining for other players and mobs too, not just for you.
munch.options.eating.tooltip: Food loses a bite every time you chew, until only a small piece is left.
munch.options.drinking.tooltip: Potions, milk, honey and stews empty as you drink or eat them.
munch.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to how it was when you installed Munch.
